forbidden.name: modules-cross-boundary-must-use-barrel
forbidden.comment: Cross-module imports (A != B) may only target src/modules/<B>/index.ts. Same-module deep imports and target *.module.ts files are exempt.

forbidden.name: modules-cross-boundary-repositories-dto-forbidden
forbidden.comment: Cross-module imports (A != B) may never target src/modules/<B>/(repositories|dto)/**.

forbidden.name: common-no-module-imports
forbidden.comment: src/common/** must not import from src/modules/**.

forbidden.name: modules-no-direct-redis-clients
forbidden.comment: src/modules/** must not import ioredis or keyv directly (use the src/common redis/cache/queue wrappers).

forbidden.name: ddd-domain-purity
forbidden.comment: src/modules/**/domain/** may only import from other files inside the same domain/ tree (pure domain: no framework, no I/O). Type-only imports are exempt.

forbidden.name: ddd-application-no-infra-or-adapters
forbidden.comment: src/modules/**/application/** must not import from any module's infrastructure/ or adapters/ trees.

forbidden.name: ddd-adapters-no-infrastructure
forbidden.comment: src/modules/**/adapters/** must not import from any module's infrastructure/ tree.

forbidden.name: ddd-infrastructure-no-adapters
forbidden.comment: src/modules/**/infrastructure/** must not import from any module's adapters/ tree.

forbidden.name: ddd-application-no-direct-prisma
forbidden.comment: src/modules/**/application/** must not import @prisma/client or src/prisma/** (use repository implementations).

forbidden.name: modules-cross-boundary-ddd-internals-forbidden
forbidden.comment: Cross-module imports (A != B) may never target src/modules/<B>/(domain|application|adapters|infrastructure)/** even when inside the same repo — go through the owning module barrel or its ports.
